projects.title: Coopr
projects.description: A Raspberry Pi based Chicken Coop Controller. An iPhone app allows control of the coop door, collection of environmental data, and live streaming of the coop. The backend services run off Azure IoT Hub. Currently writing a P2P video layer using WebRTC.

projects.title: PiFi
projects.description:
PiFi allows the Wi-Fi settings of a Raspberry Pi to easily be set in a headless configuration. When Wi-Fi is lost on the Pi, it turns into an access point and an API becomes available. An iOS app was created to interface with this API and is available on the App Store.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pifi/id1413398570
